instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_fixed_chunks, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/fixed_chunks.dart: List<List<int>> chunkIntegers(List<int> input, int chunkSize). Partition signed input integers into consecutive independent nonempty chunks of at most chunkSize, preserving order. Last chunk can be shorter. A zero or negative chunkSize throws ArgumentError, including for empty input. Return new lists, do not mutate input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
